title: Application of artificial intelligence to the electrocardiogram

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Application of artificial intelligence to the electrocardiogram》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence (AI) has given the electrocardiogram (ECG) and clinicians reading them super-human diagnostic abilities.

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) has given the electrocardiogram (ECG) and clinicians reading them super-human diagnostic abilities.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Application of artificial intelligence to the electrocardiogram》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Trained without hard-coded rules by finding often subclinical patterns in huge datasets, AI transforms the ECG, a ubiquitous, non-invasive cardiac test that is integrated into practice workflows, into a screening tool and predictor of cardiac and non-cardiac diseases, often in asymptomatic individuals.
